plain: Nice work decoding this warmup! To solve, submit this exact answer to the Game Master: amber-falcon-31
generator_cmd: PYTHONPATH=tools/pyciphers python3 -c "import secretpy as S; S.Playfair().encrypt(LETTERS, KEY)".upper()  # letters of the sentence, lowercased, J->I
oracle_cmd: PYTHONPATH=tools/pyciphers python3 -c "import pycipher as P; print(P.Playfair(SQUARE(KEY)).decipher(encoded).lower())"  # SQUARE = keyword letters (J->I) deduped + rest of A-Z sans J; raw output keeps the X fillers
